theorems.name: Submission.imrep_represents_massOn_eq_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.massOn W = R.measure W
